summary: First-run E2E test of JARVIS AI. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass against all listed /api endpoints (stats, commands, notes CRUD, logs, config sanitization, devices, applications, cyber tools, gmail status configured, gmail OAuth 307 redirect to accounts.google.com, whatsapp mocked, chat billing path). Frontend: dashboard loads with every panel (Statistiques Système with CPU/RAM/GPU/Disque, Statistiques IA, Réseau, Dernières Commandes, Mes Emails Récents, WhatsApp, Cybersécurité, Code & Pense-bête, top clock, SYSTEM ONLINE). All left-sidebar nav testids render their view without crashing. Notes CRUD works via UI (create + delete propagates to backend). Voice console send-btn -> POST /api/chat returns the expected friendly billing message ('Ma clé Claude fonctionne, mais le solde de crédits ... Anthropic ...') shown in conversation-feed. Cyber input enables scan buttons. Settings save persists wake_word, model, key state and shows 'ENREGISTRÉ ✓' confirmation; GET /api/config exposes anthropic_api_key_set=true without raw key. 3D avatar renders (WebGL available).
critical_code_review_comments: Cyber scan button testids are cyber-scan-nmap / cyber-scan-nmap_full / cyber-scan-nmap_vuln / cyber-scan-dirb. Review request mentions 'cyber-scan-nmap etc.' — naming works but consider aliasing to more readable ids (cyber-scan-ports, cyber-scan-vuln) for testability.

backend/agent.py: broad Exception catch swallows non-billing errors as generic 500-style reply; consider distinguishing anthropic.APIStatusError subtypes (RateLimitError, APIConnectionError) for better UX.
api.py PUT /api/config: patch = {k:v for k,v in ... if v is not None} will not allow clearing lists/dicts intentionally (e.g., empty allowed_folders). Minor.
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET is committed in backend/.env. Consider secret rotation before publishing repo.
seed_data_creation: Test note (TEST_UI_Note) and TEST_sess conversation created & cleaned during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Anthropic account is billing-blocked; /api/chat returns {ok:false, billing:true, reply:<French billing message>}. Do NOT flag as bug. Gmail OAuth is configured but no user token — /api/gmail/status returns configured:true, connected:false. WhatsApp is intentionally mocked. Backend has hot-reload; supervisor restart only for .env changes.
